name: How often should a water pressure regulator be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How often should a water pressure regulator be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water pressure regulators typically last between 10 to 15 years, but their lifespan can vary depending on water quality, consistent high pressure, and the specific model. Signs that a regulator might need replacement include fluctuating water pressure, a sudden increase in water noise, or visible leaks near the device. Regular inspections by CG Plumbing Solutions can help determine if your regulator is reaching the end of its service life and advise on timely replacement to prevent major plumbing issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regulators generally last 10-15 years. Replace if you notice fluctuating pressure, increased water noise, or leaks.
